question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 is the first report covering post-September revenue (due ~Nov 3-17). Q2 revenue was $7.8B (+92% YoY), beating the ~$6.9B consensus by ~13%. Q3 consensus is $12.9B (range $11.1-16.0B across 12 analysts). UBS is at $13.8B, assuming AI revenue of $7.6B from Anthropic plus Google, Connectivity of $4.9B and Space of $1.3B. More conservative views put AI at about $3.75B, which implies roughly $10-10.5B total. The median sits near consensus because the Q2 beat argues upside while AI ramp timing argues downside. No human market (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold) prices Q3 revenue; only IPO, valuation and merger markets exist.

- SpaceX IPO'd on Nasdaq June 12, 2026 (SPCX), at $135/share and a ~$1.77T valuation (predictionnews/Polymarket coverage).
- Q2 2026 (reported ~Aug 4, 2026; Fortune/CBS): revenue $7.8B, +92% YoY from $4.1B. Space $962M (+29%), Connectivity $4,291M (+66%), AI $2,561M (+248%). Net loss $541M; adj. EBITDA $3.5B. Pre-report consensus was ~$6.9B, so actual beat by ~$0.9B (~13%).
- Starlink: 12M subscribers at end of Q2; ARPU $66/month (flat QoQ, down from $85 a year earlier); May price increases should show up in Q3 (Yahoo/Motley Fool, Oct 2, 2026).
- Launches: 40 Falcon launches in Q1, 37 in Q2; Q3 watch level 41+ (Yahoo, Oct 2). UBS assumes 35 launches and Space revenue of $1.3B.
- AI segment: Seeking Alpha author says AI infrastructure revenue was $2.2B in Q2 and expects roughly $5.0B in Q3 as Anthropic expanded its commitments. Yahoo (Oct 2) puts the threshold at $3.75B+ ('one customer at full rate ~$3.75B/quarter'). UBS models AI at $7.6B (Anthropic expansion plus initial Google contribution).
- Sell-side (Yahoo/Stocktwits, ~Oct 2026): Q3 revenue consensus $12.9B; range among 12 analysts $11.1B-$16.0B. UBS at $13.8B, with Connectivity $4.9B (+59% YoY).
- Musk stated a target of a $100B annualized revenue run rate by end of 2026 (about $25B/quarter).
- H1 2026 AI capex was $23.6B (vs $3.3B a year earlier); Q2 capex was $18.4B.
- Report date unconfirmed: Stocktwits says Nov 3 after close; other calendars say Nov 5 or Nov 17.
- Status quo: the first figure reported after September will be the Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) quarterly revenue in the earnings release.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off SpaceX's reported quarterly total revenue (Q3 2026 earnings release), not run-rate or segment figures. Criteria text was blank in the prompt; bounds are $10B-$16B, open both ends.
- Event window: report expected Nov 3-17, 2026; as of Oct 13 the quarter has closed and the report is pending.
- Searched for and did not find: a prediction market on Q3 revenue (none on Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold); official company Q3 guidance; any mid-quarter revenue pre-announcement.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the quantity (Q3 2026 total revenue), the Q2 baseline ($7.81B, +13% beat), consensus ~$12.9B (one aggregator ~$13.1B) and UBS $13.8B. Disputes: (1) Q2 AI $2.56B vs $2.2B is a definitional difference (segment vs AI-solutions line) and immaterial. (2) Anthropic Q3 contribution: the runs cite a May-June ramp, so I treated it as mostly full-rate in Q3. (3) Google Q3 contribution: UBS includes an initial amount, and the dossiers say only a 'reduced fee' before October. I could not settle this without web access, so it stays the main uncertainty. (4) Cursor consolidation ~$0.4-0.5B is plausible but unconfirmed. (5) Weight of the Q2 beat is judgment; with n=1 I tilted only slightly above consensus. Run 1's dispersion is carried forward, slightly narrowed. No web retrieval this run.
